PMI.name: Palma de Mallorca Airport
PMI.local_name: Aeropuerto de Palma de Mallorca (Son Sant Joan)
PMI.status_summary: Major hub currently undergoing multi-phase terminal remodelling. Aena is piloting 3D CT scanners on select lanes, but standard passenger lanes require standard liquid and laptop removal.

scanner_status.hardware_label: Phased 3D CT Scanner Trials (Select Lanes) / Standard 2D X-Ray (Dominant)
scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Pack as if using legacy 2D X-ray: keep liquids under 100ml in a single 1L clear resealable bag and remove laptops and tablets at the checkpoint unless specifically instructed otherwise by security staff.

liquids.exemptions: Baby food/milk and prescription medicines (with doctor note or prescription) required during the flight are permitted above 100ml but must be declared separately.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Place large camera bodies or drone chassis in separate plastic trays.
electronics.power_banks: Cabin baggage only. Must not exceed 100Wh without airline authorization (max 160Wh with approval). Prohibited in checked hold luggage.

physical_prep.shoes: Remove ankle-high boots, high heels, or thick platform soles. Standard sneakers and flat sandals usually remain on unless requested.
physical_prep.belts: Remove metal buckle belts into tray.
physical_prep.outerwear: Remove coats, jackets, hats, and heavy hoodies into trays.
physical_prep.smartwatches: Standard smartwatches may typically remain on wrist unless passing through body scanner with secondary alerts.

regional_hazards.name: Mallorcan Olive Oil (Oli de Mallorca)
regional_hazards.reason: Liquid volume limit. Artisanal bottles and metal tins bought at markets exceed 100ml.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked baggage wrapped in padded clothing, or buy after security at the duty-free shop in sealed STEB bags.

regional_hazards.name: Hierbas Mallorquinas & Palo de Mallorca
regional_hazards.reason: Bottles over 100ml purchased outside the airport are confiscated at security.
regional_hazards.advice: Place in checked luggage or purchase post-security in the departures shopping concourse.

regional_hazards.name: Large Sunscreen & Aftersun Lotions
regional_hazards.reason: Top confiscated item in Mallorca. Even 200ml bottles that are half-empty are seized based on container capacity.
regional_hazards.advice: Decant into 100ml reusable travel bottles or leave remaining bottles behind.

regional_hazards.name: Ensaimadas (Traditional Mallorcan Pastry)
regional_hazards.reason: Passes security screening without restriction as a solid baked good.
regional_hazards.advice: Security permits them, but budget airlines (like Ryanair) may count the octagonal box as an extra piece of cabin baggage.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Intense seasonal peaks driven by concentrated UK and German charter package turnaround schedules.

peak_windows.driver: Mass European charter arrivals/departures and weekend turnover.
Mainland commuter flights to Madrid and Barcelona.

data_references.title: Aena Official Palma de Mallorca Airport Portal
Aena Passenger Security Controls & Hand Luggage Rules
European Commission Re-imposition of 100ml Limit on C3 Scanners (Sept 1, 2024)

IBZ.name: Ibiza Airport
IBZ.status_summary: Single-terminal seasonal island airport experiencing extreme peak congestion during summer clubbing weekends. Standard 2D X-ray screening on all regular passenger lanes.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Strict removal required: take out all liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and place laptops, tablets, and gaming consoles in separate security trays.

liquids.exemptions: Medicines and infant formula declared separately.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Separate trays for professional cameras, DJ equipment, and audio gear.
electronics.power_banks: Cabin baggage only (max 100Wh). Prohibited in checked luggage.

physical_prep.shoes: Platform shoes, festival boots, and metal-reinforced footwear must be scanned in trays.
physical_prep.outerwear: Remove hoodies, festival jackets, and sunglasses.

regional_hazards.name: Hierbas Ibicencas (Herbal Liqueur)
regional_hazards.reason: Famous aniseed herb liqueur bottled in 500ml/1L formats; seized at security if in cabin baggage.
regional_hazards.advice: Check in your suitcase or buy from Ibiza airport duty-free post-security.

regional_hazards.name: Ibiza Sea Salt & Island Olive Oil
regional_hazards.reason: Oils are liquid (>100ml confiscated). Artisanal sea salt in large jars may trigger powder secondary inspection.
regional_hazards.advice: Keep salts in checked luggage or small containers; oils must be checked.

regional_hazards.name: Sun Cream, Bronzing Oils & Glitter Lotions
regional_hazards.reason: Bottles over 100ml cannot enter security lanes.
regional_hazards.advice: Decant into travel bottles before heading to the airport.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Sharply concentrated congestion corresponding to weekend club event check-outs and European charter turnaround schedules.

peak_windows.driver: Massive post-weekend departure wave of European clubbers and package travelers.

MAH.name: Menorca Airport
MAH.status_summary: Relaxed family-oriented island airport with conventional 2D X-ray security. High summer weekend surges during package holiday turnaround hours.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: liquids under 100ml in transparent 1L zip bag and laptops/tablets removed into trays.

liquids.exemptions: Baby foods, sterilised water, and prescription medicines permitted with declaration.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots and thick-soled shoes must be scanned in trays.

regional_hazards.name: Gin Xoriguer (Menorcan Mahón Gin)
regional_hazards.reason: Iconic clay and glass bottles of Mahón gin are confiscated if over 100ml in hand luggage.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack bottles in checked luggage or buy post-security at Menorca duty-free.

regional_hazards.name: Mahón-Menorca Cheese (Formatge de Maó)
regional_hazards.reason: Hard/cured varieties are solid and permitted. Soft or semi-cured cheese packed with oils/liquids may trigger confiscation.
regional_hazards.advice: Ensure cheese is cured and solid; avoid liquid or brine packaging in cabin bags.

regional_hazards.name: Family Size Sun Protection Lotions
regional_hazards.reason: Containers $>100$ml seized regardless of remaining contents.
regional_hazards.advice: Place in checked luggage.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Pronounced family holiday changeover waves on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays.

peak_windows.driver: UK, German, and domestic mainland package flights.

TFS.name: Tenerife South Airport
TFS.status_summary: The Canary Islands' primary international tourist gateway. Operates standard 2D X-ray security lanes with intense Tuesday and Friday charter congestion spikes.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Remove liquids under 100ml in transparent 1L plastic bag and take out all laptops, tablets, and gaming consoles into trays.

liquids.exemptions: Medicines with prescription and baby food permitted with secondary screening.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Separate trays for laptops, tablets, and handheld electronics.
electronics.power_banks: Cabin baggage only, strictly prohibited in checked hold luggage.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots, platform trainers, and boots must be taken off.
physical_prep.outerwear: Remove jackets, hoodies, and sun hats.

regional_hazards.name: Ron Miel (Canarian Honey Rum) & Banana Liqueur
regional_hazards.reason: Very popular souvenir bottles exceed 100ml and are confiscated at checkpoint.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage or buy after security at the Canariensis duty-free shop.

regional_hazards.name: Mojo Picón / Mojo Verde Sauces
regional_hazards.reason: Canarian mojo sauce is classified as a liquid/gel. Jars exceeding 100ml are confiscated.
regional_hazards.advice: Check all mojo jars in hold baggage or purchase inside duty-free.

regional_hazards.name: Volcanic Sand & Rocks from Teide National Park
regional_hazards.reason: Removing natural sand or volcanic rocks from Tenerife's protected beaches/parks is illegal under Spanish environmental law and subject to confiscation and fines.
regional_hazards.advice: Never collect natural sand or volcanic stones as souvenirs.

regional_hazards.name: Aloe Vera Gels & Aftersun Lotions
regional_hazards.reason: Local pure aloe vera gels sold in 250ml tubs will be seized.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Distinct weekly rhythm dictated by UK and northern European tour operator flight schedules.

peak_windows.driver: Major UK package holiday changeover (Jet2, TUI, EasyJet, British Airways charter banks).
German and Nordic charter departure bank.

data_references.title: Aena Official Tenerife Sur Airport Portal

ACE.name: Lanzarote Airport
ACE.status_summary: Two terminals: Terminal 1 serves all international and mainland Spanish flights; Terminal 2 serves inter-island flights. Conventional 2D X-ray screening.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: separate liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and remove laptops, tablets, and bulky electronic devices.

liquids.exemptions: Prescription liquid medicines and baby milk/food.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Electronic items must be removed into trays.
electronics.power_banks: Carry-on only, strictly prohibited in checked hold baggage.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots and thick soles require tray scanning.

regional_hazards.name: Malvasía Volcanic Wine & Canarian Rum
regional_hazards.reason: Famous La Geria volcanic vineyard wine bottles exceed 100ml and cannot pass security.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack securely in checked luggage or buy inside Terminal 1 duty-free after security.

regional_hazards.name: Volcanic Black Sand & Olivine Crystals
regional_hazards.reason: Taking volcanic sand or natural olivine from Lanzarote beaches/parks is illegal under Spanish biodiversity laws.
regional_hazards.advice: Do not collect natural sand, pebbles, or volcanic rocks.

regional_hazards.name: Canarian Mojo Sauces & Jams
regional_hazards.reason: Mojo sauce in glass jars exceeds 100ml and is seized.
regional_hazards.advice: Check in hold baggage or purchase post-security.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Major Thursday and Sunday spikes due to UK and Irish package charter changeovers.

peak_windows.driver: Concentrated UK and Irish package turnaround flights (T1 Departures).

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (T1)
terminals.serves: All international, UK, and mainland Spain flights

FUE.name: Fuerteventura Airport
FUE.status_summary: Single modern terminal catering heavily to European water sports enthusiasts and package tourists. Conventional 2D X-ray security checkpoint.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: separate liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and remove laptops, tablets, and drone batteries.

liquids.exemptions: Medicines and infant nutrition declared separately.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Drones and action cameras out into trays.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking/sports boots and thick soles into trays.

regional_hazards.name: Majorero Goat Cheese (Queso Majorero)
regional_hazards.reason: Hard/cured Majorero wheels pass security without issue. Soft/fresh goat cheeses or cheese preserved in oil are considered liquids/gels.
regional_hazards.advice: Stick to cured/semi-cured solid wheels or pack in checked luggage.

regional_hazards.name: Canarian Honey Rum (Ron Miel)
regional_hazards.reason: Bottles over 100ml confiscated at checkpoint.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage or purchase in duty-free after security.

regional_hazards.name: Corralejo White Sand & Popcorn Beach Fossils
regional_hazards.reason: Popcorn Beach (Playa del Bajo de la Burra) rhodolith fossils and white sand are strictly protected. Removing them is illegal and penalised by Guardia Civil.
regional_hazards.advice: Do not take rhodoliths or beach sand under any circumstances.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Intense Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday peaks aligned with German and UK package flight turnovers.

peak_windows.driver: Heavy German and UK holiday flight banks.

HER.name: Heraklion International Airport
HER.status_summary: Crete's primary airport and one of Greece's busiest. Aging terminal infrastructure operating legacy 2D X-ray systems with notoriously high summer confiscation rates for Cretan olive oil, honey, and raki.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Strict manual unpack: All liquids must be in 100ml containers inside a clear 1L resealable bag. Laptops, tablets, and large electronics must be placed in separate trays.

liquids.exemptions: Essential medicines and infant formula accompanied by a guardian.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Laptops and tablets in separate individual trays.
electronics.power_banks: Cabin baggage only, max 100Wh. Forbidden in checked hold luggage.

physical_prep.shoes: Boots and thick soles must be scanned in trays.

regional_hazards.name: Cretan Extra Virgin Olive Oil (Kolymvari / Sitia)
regional_hazards.reason: Top confiscated item in Greece. Hundreds of litres seized weekly. Metal tins, glass bottles, and farm-fresh jugs over 100ml are strictly confiscated.
regional_hazards.advice: Must be packed in checked hold luggage (double-bagged in plastic) or purchased after security inside the Hellenic Duty Free Shops in a sealed STEB bag.

regional_hazards.name: Cretan Thyme Honey (Thymarisio Meli)
regional_hazards.reason: Honey is legally classified as a liquid/gel under EU aviation security rules. Jars over 100ml are seized without exception.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked baggage or buy inside post-security duty-free.

regional_hazards.name: Feta & Graviera Cheese in Brine / Olive Oil
regional_hazards.reason: Cheese packed in brine or oil is deemed a liquid. Soft cheese (like Mizithra or Anthotyros) is also treated as a paste/gel.
regional_hazards.advice: Vacuum-packed hard cured Graviera or Kefalotyri passes security; brine-packed or soft cheese must be checked in the hold.

regional_hazards.name: Cretan Tsikoudia (Raki) & Ouzo
regional_hazards.reason: Artisanal plastic bottles or souvenir glass flasks over 100ml are confiscated.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage or purchase inside the airport duty-free shop.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Severe congestion during peak summer charter flight turnaround waves, exacerbated by compact terminal space.

peak_windows.driver: Mass charter turnaround banks for UK, German, French, and Polish package flights.

data_references.title: Hellenic Civil Aviation Passenger Security Regulations
EASA European Aviation Safety Agency Passenger Security Guidelines

CHQ.name: Chania International Airport
CHQ.status_summary: Modernised terminal managed by Fraport Greece. Operates conventional 2D X-ray security lanes with strict confiscation of local olive oils and raki.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: separate liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and remove laptops, tablets, and e-readers.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Electronic items out into separate trays.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots and thick soles require separate tray scanning.

regional_hazards.name: Chania Extra Virgin Olive Oil (Chania PGI)
regional_hazards.reason: Bottles and tins $>100$ml confiscated at checkpoint.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage or buy inside post-security duty-free.

regional_hazards.name: Cretan Raki / Tsikoudia
regional_hazards.reason: Artisanal spirit bottles over 100ml confiscated.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked hold baggage.

regional_hazards.name: Cretan Pine & Thyme Honey
regional_hazards.reason: Classified as liquid/gel; $>100$ml seized.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Major Nordic, UK, and German charter turnover peaks on Wednesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays.

peak_windows.driver: Scandinavian and UK charter turnaround banks.

RHO.name: Rhodes International Airport
RHO.status_summary: Extensively upgraded by Fraport Greece with modernised check-in and security hall, but utilizing conventional 2D X-ray lanes requiring liquid and laptop extraction.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: separate liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and remove laptops, tablets, and gaming devices.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Electronic items out into separate trays.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots, military boots, and thick platform soles must be scanned in trays.

regional_hazards.name: Rhodian Olive Oil
regional_hazards.reason: Bottles and tins $>100$ml confiscated at checkpoint.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage or buy inside post-security duty-free.

regional_hazards.name: Rhodian Thyme & Pine Honey
regional_hazards.reason: Honey is treated as a liquid/gel; $>100$ml seized.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage.

regional_hazards.name: Souma (Rhodian Pomace Brandy) & Ouzo
regional_hazards.reason: Bottles over 100ml confiscated at checkpoint.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked hold baggage or buy inside post-security duty-free.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Massive Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday peaks aligned with UK, German, and Polish charter turnaround waves.

data_references.title: Fraport Greece Official Rhodes Airport Portal

CFU.name: Corfu International Airport
CFU.status_summary: Compact scenic island terminal upgraded by Fraport Greece with expanded security area, operating conventional 2D X-ray lanes. Severe peaks on Mondays and Fridays.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: separate liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and remove laptops, tablets, and e-readers.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Electronic items out into separate trays.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots and thick soles require tray scanning.

regional_hazards.name: Kumquat Liqueur & Corfu Limoncello
regional_hazards.reason: Corfu's trademark bright orange kumquat liqueur bottles are confiscated if over 100ml in hand luggage.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage or buy after security inside Hellenic Duty Free.

regional_hazards.name: Corfiot Olive Oil (The Governor / Lianolia)
regional_hazards.reason: High-phenolic Corfiot olive oil bottles exceed 100ml and are seized at checkpoint.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack securely in checked luggage or purchase post-security.

regional_hazards.name: Sunscreen & Tanning Lotions
regional_hazards.reason: Containers $>100$ml confiscated.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack in checked luggage.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Monday and Friday peaks are legendary due to UK package holiday turnaround flight schedules.

peak_windows.driver: Concentrated UK and German charter turnaround flights.

data_references.title: Fraport Greece Official Corfu Airport Portal

JTR.name: Santorini International Airport
JTR.status_summary: Expanded terminal modernised by Fraport Greece. Handles immense tourist flows with conventional 2D X-ray screening. Frequent confiscation of Assyrtiko wine, Vinsanto, and fava pastes.

scanner_status.passenger_instruction: Standard screening: separate liquids (under 100ml in transparent 1L bag) and remove laptops, tablets, and e-readers.

electronics.cameras_and_drones: Electronic items out into separate trays.

physical_prep.shoes: Hiking boots and thick soles require tray scanning.

regional_hazards.name: Vinsanto & Assyrtiko Santorini Wines
regional_hazards.reason: World-famous volcanic wine bottles exceed 100ml and cannot pass security.
regional_hazards.advice: Pack securely in checked luggage or buy inside post-security duty-free.

regional_hazards.name: Santorini Fava Bean Puree & Caper Pastes
regional_hazards.reason: Jarred fava pastes, tapenades, and pickled caper leaves in brine are classified as liquids/pastes.
regional_hazards.advice: Dry dried fava beans are solid and allowed; jarred pastes must be checked in luggage.

regional_hazards.name: Red Beach & Black Beach Volcanic Pebbles / Sand
regional_hazards.reason: Taking volcanic pebbles or red/black sand is discouraged and bags of pebbles may be inspected or removed by security.
regional_hazards.advice: Leave volcanic sand and pebbles on the beaches.

congestion_rhythms.summary: Severe daily peak surges matching caldera tour check-outs, ferry transfers, and European charter flight rotations.

peak_windows.driver: Hotel checkouts, ferry connections, and international charter departures.

data_references.title: Fraport Greece Official Santorini Airport Portal
